PTree.Interp.ExceptionFoldFacts.exception_fold_square
endpoints.type:
@ExceptionFoldFacts.exception_fold_square
     : forall (Err : Type) (E MN T : Type -> Type) (MT : Monad.Monad T) (QT : Monad.Eq1 T),
       @Monad.Eq1Equivalence T MT QT ->
       @Monad.MonadLawsE T QT MT ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> T X) (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> T X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A),
       @Monad.eq1 T QT (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (Err + A) + (Err + A))
         (@Monad.bind T MT
            (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A + (Err + A))
            (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (Err + A) + (Err + A))
            (@ExceptionFoldFacts.exception_fold_step Err E MN T MT handle sample A t)
            (fun v : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A + (Err + A) =>
             @Monad.ret T MT (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (Err + A) + (Err + A))
               (@IterationLaws.iteration_map
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A)
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (Err + A)) (Err + A)
                  (@Exception.run_exception Err E MN A) v)))
         (@Fold.fold_step E MN T MT handle sample (Err + A) (@Exception.run_exception Err E MN A t))

@ExceptionFold.exception_fold_commutes
     : forall (Err : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.ExceptionFold.exception_throw_fold
endpoints.type:
@ExceptionFold.exception_throw_fold
     : forall (Err : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (err : Err),
       @Eqit.eutt F (Err + A) (Err + A) (@eq (Err + A))
         (@ExceptionFold.fold_exception Err E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A) Empty_set
                  (@Sum.inl1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E Empty_set (@Exception.Throw Err err))
                  (fun v : Empty_set =>
                   match
                     v return (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A)
                   with
                   end)
            |})
         {|
           ITreeDefinition._observe :=
             @ITreeDefinition.RetF F (Err + A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (Err + A)) (@inl Err A err)
         |}

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.ExceptionFold.exception_probability_fold
endpoints.type:
@ExceptionFold.exception_probability_fold
     : forall (Err : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A X : Type) (mu : MN X)
         (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A),
       @Eqit.eutt F (Err + A) (Err + A) (@eq (Err + A))
         (@ExceptionFold.fold_exception Err E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.ProbF (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A) X mu k
            |})
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X (Err + A) (sample X mu)
            (fun x : X =>
             @ExceptionFold.fold_exception Err E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
               A (k x)))

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.ExceptionFold.sample_then_exception
endpoints.type:
@ExceptionFold.sample_then_exception
     : forall (Err : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (X A : Type) (mu : MN X) (err : Err),
       @Eqit.eutt F (Err + A) (Err + A) (@eq (Err + A))
         (@ExceptionFold.fold_exception Err E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.ProbF (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A) X mu
                  (fun _ : X =>
                   {|
                     PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                       @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A
                         (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A)
                         Empty_set
                         (@Sum.inl1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E Empty_set (@Exception.Throw Err err))
                         (fun v : Empty_set =>
                          match
                            v
                            return
                              (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Exception.exceptE Err) E) MN A)
                          with
                          end)
                   |})
            |})
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X (Err + A) (sample X mu)
            (fun _ : X =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.RetF F (Err + A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (Err + A))
                   (@inl Err A err)
             |}))

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.ExceptionFold.recursive_exception_square
endpoints.type:
@ExceptionFold.recursive_exception_square
     : forall (MN F : Type -> Type) (mu : MN bool)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (handle : forall X : Type, ExceptionFold.requestE X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X),
       @Eqit.eutt F (nat + bool) (nat + bool) (@eq (nat + bool))
         (@ExceptionFold.fold_exception nat ExceptionFold.requestE MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
            bool (@ExceptionFold.retry_or_throw MN mu))
         (@Fold.fold ExceptionFold.requestE MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
            (nat + bool)
            (@Exception.run_exception nat ExceptionFold.requestE MN bool
               (@ExceptionFold.retry_or_throw MN mu)))
